defs.def: happening or existing before the event or object that you are talking about 先前的；以往的

ex.s: The team focused only on three common types — polystyrene, polyethylene and polypropylene — and they didn’t study other chemicals previously found in water such as vinyl chloride.
ex.t: 该团队只关注三种常见类型——聚苯乙烯、聚乙烯和聚丙烯——他们没有研究之前在水中发现的其他化学物质，如氯乙烯。

ex.s: It can be imagined that comparable to the process of building previous scientific models, developing the “computer simulation” metaphor-based model will also be a hugely rewarding exercise.
ex.t: 可以想象，与构建以往科学模型的过程类似，发展这种基于"计算机模拟"隐喻的模型也将是一项极具价值的实践。

ex.s: compare the current models with the previous ones
ex.t: 将当前模型与以前的模型进行比较

ex.s: Some instructors choose to put previous test papers on library reserve,  making them available to all students.
ex.t: 一些教师选择把往年试卷放在图书馆 reserve，让所有学生都能借阅。

ex.s: Class activities will vary from day to day, but students must be ready to complete short in-class writings or tests drawn directly from assigned readings or notes from the previous class' lecture/discussion, so it is important to take careful notes during class.
ex.t: 课堂活动每天不同，但学生必须准备好完成直接取自指定阅读或上节课讲座/讨论笔记的简短课堂写作或测试，所以课堂上认真记笔记很重要。

ex.s: But compared with previous studies, she finds the speed of breaking down in this one exciting.
ex.t: 但与之前的研究相比，她发现这项研究中分解的速度令人兴奋。

ex.s: They can refer back to previous information or forward to new information.
ex.t: 它们可以回指之前的信息，或指向新的信息。

ex.s: At that time, the most common way to study horse painting was by copying the works of previous painters.
ex.t: 当时，学习画马最常用的方法就是临摹前代画家的作品。

ex.s: Everyone knows that success rarely happens overnight, but perhaps not many know that a lot of highly successful writers have previously faced rejection.
ex.t: 每个人都知道成功很少一蹴而就，但也许很多人不知道，许多非常成功的作家都曾经历过被拒稿。

defs.def: immediately before the time you are talking about （时间上）稍前的

ex.s: People sit uncomfortably on plastic chairs, looking through old magazines, all of which have been read hundreds of times previously.
ex.t: 人们不舒服地坐在塑料椅子上，翻阅着旧杂志，所有这些杂志之前都已经被翻阅过数百次了。

ex.s: Every single member of the team gave their all to the fight, including Hui Ruoqi who had had heart surgery less than five months previously.
ex.t: 团队的每一位成员都全力以赴投入战斗，包括不到五个月前刚做了心脏手术的惠若琪。
